This change is ready for review.

Abandoned

abandon since it's a low priority change and been pending for 3 months
Why is this not being reviewed? It's an open change since February 24.

1. Where is the EM side patch for this change? I am sure there is a pending conversation on that based on last comment from Ed.
2. Is anyone waiting for this Intel specific change? I don't think so, hence its a lower priority change at the moment, unless i am incorrect and someone is looking for this change?
In general, we will definitely take this but once we have resolved other higher priority tasks at hand.

1. I don't think there is any project-wide requirement to have a change merged for the EM schema to merge a feature. EM is intended for the configuration use-case and may lag behind somewhat. There is always room to adjust the code if the config needs to look different from the EM side.

I had initially dropped the ME support in the schema since there was too much discussion happening and no concrete ideas. I don't see the value to start so many new discussions if there is still 10+ patches waiting on feedback. So we can move forward with ME support and later figure out how to configure it.

2. I need the change to support a use-case for a board i already tested (Tyan S5549). Do you think this board should not be supported by the OpenBMC project?.
If the change is not needed, why would i push this change?
